calls.reason: R Street papers by Thierer (Mar–Apr 2023) reject top-down AI mandates in favor of permissionless innovation, and Hanson in Reason says now is not the time to regulate AI, showing visible libertarian resistance.
GPT-5 shipped in August 2025; Altman said at launch it had not reached AGI, and METR's evaluation found genuine failures on human-baselined tasks.
The only evidence is a 2023 survey calling neurosymbolic AI an increasingly active field; nothing measures its relative prominence, maturity, or venture funding.
OpenAI's GPT-4 disclosure admits bad behavior and jailbreaks remain possible after mitigation, and an April 2023 study found persona prompts raised ChatGPT toxicity up to 6x.
The UK framework was non-statutory, but Italy's Garante ordered OpenAI to correct or erase inaccurate personal data, and no comprehensive legal review was found, so the evidence is mixed.
